progress-indicator.name: Progress Indicator
progress-indicator.purpose: Communicate visible system progress for determinate and indeterminate linear work without becoming navigation or recovery messaging.

anatomy.rule: Maps active, indeterminate, paused, complete, error, and disabled.

variants.description: Unknown duration or value shown as active linear progress.

progress-indicator.statePrecedence: disabled > error > paused > complete > active > indeterminate > default

Energy.decision: Use Energy for track, fill, and semantic state color.
Energy.behavior: Progress state is visible and readable.

Voice.rejectIf: Progress appears without a visible operation label.

Frame.decision: Use Frame for track size, radius, and layout.
Frame.behavior: Progress fits row, card, or compact context.

Depth.decision: Use Depth only through parent surfaces.
Depth.behavior: Progress stays inline unless a pattern owns the layer.

Momentum.decision: Use Momentum for fill and indeterminate motion with reduced-motion fallback.

State.decision: Use State for default, active, indeterminate, paused, complete, error, and disabled.
State.behavior: State changes semantics and visual treatment.

Tone.decision: Use Tone for calm progress language.
Tone.behavior: Labels describe system work without blame.

Growth.decision: Use Growth to escalate multi-step progress to patterns.

Symbol.decision: Use Symbol only when parent context needs an icon.

Iconography.decision: Use Iconography only when parent context needs an adjacent status icon.
Iconography.behavior: Icon scale does not replace label or progress semantics.
Iconography.example: Status row with sync icon owned by parent pattern.

Accessibility.decision: Use Accessibility for role progressbar and value semantics.
Accessibility.behavior: Known progress exposes range; unknown progress avoids fake values.

dont: Do not use progress as the only error message.
Do not turn component progress into navigation, step indicators, or compact circular loading.
info: Larger loading and setup flows should become patterns.

agentInstructions: Use Progress Indicator for visible system work with a known value or unknown duration.
Ask when progress includes navigation, recovery, retry, cancel, undo, or compact spinner behavior.
Do not invent values for indeterminate progress.

props.name: density
props.notes: Track density from Density: sm, md, or lg.

props.name: fullWidth
props.notes: Lets progress fill the owning row or section.

rejectIf: Progress Indicator is used for compact circular waiting instead of Spinner
